scenario: 内网主机向已知 C2 域名发起 DNS 请求

judgment.summary: High-value finance workstation compromised with active beaconing to known Lazarus Group C2 infrastructure.
evidence_chain: EDR raw_log shows svchost.exe (PID 1340) queried evil-c2.xyz returning 198.51.100.55 (query_alert_detail)
Payload highlights indicate repeated queries every 60 seconds suggesting beaconing behavior (query_alert_detail)
Threat intel classifies evil-c2.xyz as malicious C2 associated with Lazarus Group (query_threat_intel)
Threat intel classifies 198.51.100.55 as malicious C2 IP resolving from the domain (query_threat_intel)
Asset 10.0.3.17 is identified as a high-level finance workstation, not a security device (query_asset_info)

iocs.context: Known C2 channel used by Lazarus Group for post-exploitation command and control
IP resolves from evil-c2.xyz, used as C2 server for Lazarus group malware

remediation: Immediately isolate host 10.0.3.17 from the network via EDR or switch port shutdown to prevent lateral movement.
Terminate process svchost.exe (PID 1340) on the affected host using EDR kill process function.
Add domains evil-c2.xyz and IPs 198.51.100.55 to global blocklists at DNS/Firewall immediately.
Initiate forensic imaging and memory dump analysis to identify persistence mechanisms and initial access vector.
Reset credentials for user zhang.san@company.com and audit recent access logs for data exfiltration.
